strings.(칼리 마을 안쪽, 메디아만 볼 수 있는 짙은 어둠 사이로 누군가의 모습: (Deep inside Kali, a figure continues speaking from within a thick darkness only Medea can see.)
I had hoped you would stay out of this.
strings.당신이 절 어떤 목적으로 곁에 두셨는지는 모릅니다. 하지만, 어느 순간: I don't know why you kept me by your side. But when I discovered I had a name other than Medea...
I began to resent you. Those hazy memories I recovered from the abyss where you imprisoned them...
strings.그것과 당신이 사라진 이유엔 뭔가 있을 거라 믿고 있었습니다만, 이젠 아: I believed there was a reason for those memories, and for your disappearance. I no longer do.
You abandoned your responsibilities as leader of the Kali tribe. That alone is reason enough. You watched everything as I led our people here, though I was only a child.
strings.제가 없을 때 제 행세까지 하시고…. 당신은 우리를 버렸으면서 왜 찾아오: You even impersonated me while I was away... You abandoned us. Why come back now? This isn't the night you've been waiting for. Why?!
You will not get what you want.
Child, is that any way to address me...?
strings.메디아 님? 지금 누구랑 대화를…. 왜 여기만 어두운 거지?: Medea? Who are you talking to...? Why is it dark just here?
strings.(메디아를 부르는 %s의 목소리에 어둠 속의 인물이 짐짓 놀란다.): (The figure in the darkness seems surprised at the sound of %s calling to Medea.)
How curious. You can see this darkness and hear my voice...
strings.(무기를 쥔 %s의 손에 천천히 힘이 들어간다.): (%s slowly tightens their grip on their weapon.)
Child, I have no further business here today. I shall leave.
Adventurer, I do not know what form our next meeting will take...
But let me show you him.
(The thick darkness surrounding the woman swells until it swallows everyone.)
strings.(짙은 어둠의 일부가 흩어지면서 시야에 낯선 장소가 다가온다. 자욱한 모: (Some of the darkness disperses, revealing an unfamiliar place. Through a dense sandy haze, structures lie buried among enormous dunes.)
strings.(멈추지 않는 모래 바람 속, 한 남자가 홀로 서 있다.): (A man stands alone amid the relentless, sand-laden wind.)
strings.(저건 바이스…. 그렇다는 것은 바로 여기가 아발론?): (That's Weiss... Which means this is Avalon?)
Everything is ready. Am I the only one left...?
strings.(바이스가 %s의 등장에도 아무렇지도 않은 듯 천천히 주위를 둘러보고 있: (Weiss slowly surveys his surroundings, seemingly untroubled by %s's arrival.)
All that remains is the key...
strings.(바이스가 뭔가 이상한 걸 깨닫고 주위를 둘러본다.): (Weiss senses something amiss and looks around.)
So much has happened. I felt this way when I first came here, too...
strings.그대들이 원하는 날은 오지 않을 것이다. 이 순간을 원하는 내가 결코 물: The day you long for will never come. I have wished for this moment, and I will never back down...
strings.문을 열 준비가 됐으니 기다리고 있겠다. 여신의 모험가여…. 아발론으로: I am ready to open the door. I shall be waiting. Adventurer of the goddess... Come to Avalon.
strings.(두 사람의 시선이 마주치는 순간, %s에게로 알 수 없는 희미한 기억들: (As their eyes meet, faint, unfamiliar memories flow into %s.)
(A strange door is opening. Beings from another world are emerging, wishing for this world's destruction...)
strings.(죽어가는 사람들을 붙잡은 채로 울고 있는 한 사람….): (Someone is crying, holding people as they die...)
strings.(여기가 아닌 다른 세계가 사라져가고 있어….): (Another world, somewhere far from here, is disappearing...)
strings.알려주지. 저곳은 아즈라엘…. 이제 여신이 사랑한 세계는 아즈라엘처럼 될: I shall tell you. That is Azrael... Now the world the goddess loved will share its fate.
strings.(메디아의 목소리와 함께 시야에 가득 찼던 아발론의 모습이 흩어져 사라진: (At the sound of Medea's voice, the vision of Avalon dissolves.)
strings.어, 제가 왜…. 아니, 메디아 님? 분명… 제가 왔을 땐…. 그 사람이: Huh? Why am I... Medea? When I arrived, there was... that person... Wait, why was I crying?
And I think someone came to see you...
strings.절 아발론으로 가지 못하게 설득하려고 오신 겁니다. 하지만, 그게 되지: She came to persuade me not to go to Avalon. When she realized she couldn't, she left.
strings.그러니 바이스와의 결전에선 절대 끼어들지 않을 것입니다. 본인 '역할'도: She will not intervene in our confrontation with Weiss. She has her own 'role' to play.
Let's go. We have little time. Lady Iris is calling us.
strings.(어디선가 이리스의 따뜻한 손길 같은 바람이 불어와 %s의 품 안으로 들: (A breeze, as warm as Iris's touch, blows in from somewhere and nestles against %s.)
strings.(따뜻한 바람이 모두를 이끌어 준 장소에 도착하자 아름다운 꽃잎이 흩날린: (The warm breeze guides them to a place where beautiful flower petals dance through the air.)
So this is where Lady Iris stays.
Yes. This is where I can meet her.
strings.(%s의 말과 함께 이리스가 환한 미소로 두 사람을 맞이한다.): (As %s speaks, Iris greets them both with a radiant smile.)
It's a pleasure to see you, Lady Iris. Now that I think about it...
strings.(메디아가 가볍게 웃으며 이리스를 바라본다.): (Medea looks at Iris with a small smile.)
So this is how it feels, %s...
And you wanted to keep someone like her all to yourself...
No, I wasn't trying to... I mean, that's not...
Don't look so flustered. I'm joking.
strings.아, 메디아 님도 참…. 어, 메디아 님이?!: Oh, Medea, really... Wait, Medea is joking?!
strings.감사드려요. 그동안 많이 힘드셨을 텐데 모두를 위해서 결단을 내려주셔서…: Thank you. I know it can't have been easy, but you made that decision for everyone's sake...
strings.아닙니다. 그 힘은 온전히 제것이 아니기에 그 힘의 일부나마 돌려드린 거: Please, don't thank me. That power wasn't entirely mine. I merely returned a portion of it.
Are you sure you're all right with the choice you've made...?
strings.다시 한 번 말씀드리면 전 괜찮습니다. 남아있는 반쪽의 힘…. 이걸 덜어: As I said, I'm all right. I still don't know how to rid myself of the half that remains...
But I intend to keep trying, so I won't lose everyone...
strings.(그리고 저를 잃지 않기 위해서…. 이리스 님, 제가 다른 모습이더라 하: (And so I won't lose myself... Lady Iris, even if I take another form, please...)
strings.(이리스가 조용히 고개를 끄덕이자 메디아 또한 가볍게 웃는다.): (Iris nods quietly, and Medea smiles faintly in return.)
Now that we've said our greetings, I'll send you both to the Debora Snowfields.
strings.(이제 아발론으로 가는 게 실감나….): (It's finally sinking in. We're going to Avalon...)
%s... I'm sorry to entrust such a difficult task to you, %s. What you saw in Avalon...
I'm doing this for you, Iris, and for everyone. Because I want to.
The more I discover, the more you'll learn, too. And...
strings.바이스에게서 듣고 싶은 이야기가 있어. 그러니까 이리스, 너무 걱정하지: There are things I want Weiss to tell me. So don't worry too much, Iris.
strings.아, 위대한 벽에서 균열이 느껴져요. 저는 여기서 계속 이 균열을 최대한: Ah... I can feel cracks in the Great Wall. I'll stay here and hold them back as best I can.
Then we'll be on our way, Lady Iris.
Yes, Medea. Now, please close your eyes.
It's snowy, but it feels refreshing rather than cold.
strings.이오 님이 오랫동안 지켜온 땅이라 그럴 거예요. 아니었다면 다른 곳처럼: Perhaps because Io has protected this land for so long. Otherwise, it might have been devastated like everywhere else.
There's someone over there... He seems to be waiting for us. A Demigod...
strings.(한 남자가 데보라 설원 안쪽에 도착한 메디아와 %s의 모습을 보더니 손: (A man spots Medea and %s arriving deep in the Debora Snowfields and waves.)
strings.당신은…? 혹시 프로즌 님이신가요?: Are you... Frozen, by any chance?
strings.맞아. 내가 바로 프로즌이야. 네가 %s…, 이야기 많이 들었어. 만나서: That's me. Frozen. And you're %s... I've heard a lot about you. Nice to meet you.
It's nice to meet you, too.
strings.내가 %s에게는 말을 편하게 하고 싶은데, 괜찮을까?: I hope you don't mind if I speak casually with you, %s?
As for you, Medea, I'll address you as I would the other Champions.
Good. We haven't much time, so let's head inside.
strings.데보라 설원하고 어떤 장소를 연결했거든. 그 안에 다른 분들도 기다리고: We've connected the Debora Snowfields to another place. The others are waiting there.
So the others have arrived already. Very well. This place must be...
Yes. The place Shynic prepared... Follow me.
strings.(프로즌이 앞장서서 걸어가고, 두 사람이 뒤를 따라간다. 잠시 후, 새하: (Frozen leads the way, and the two follow. Soon the white snowfields begin to darken with an unfathomable chaos.)
strings.(아주 잠깐의 시간이 지나자 모두를 감싸던 어둠이 조금씩 사라진다. 그리: (After a brief moment, the darkness around them starts to fade, revealing a sight unlike anything they have seen before.)
strings.(밤하늘과 별이 빛나는 공간이 끝없이 펼쳐져 있고, 바깥으로 나가지 못하: (A starry night stretches endlessly before them, with bars erected to prevent anyone from leaving.)
This doesn't seem to be our world. But it isn't another world, either...
It must be the boundary between them. The Great Wall...
strings.자, 두 사람. 저쪽으로 가보세요. 샤이닉 님이 기다리고 계십니다. 저는: You two, head that way. Shynic is waiting. I'll make another patrol of Avalon.
strings.혼자 가시면 위험하지 않나요?: Isn't it dangerous to go alone?
Ren is coming with me. I'll be fine.
Oh, wait. I've heard that name somewhere...
strings.렌은 지스카드 님의 세 번째 제자야. 지금은 내 수행원이기도 하지. 너무: Ren is Ziskad's third disciple, and now my attendant as well. Don't worry.
strings.(프로즌이 물러나는 걸 알아차렸는지, 안쪽에서 거대한 데스사이드를 들고: (As though she has noticed Frozen leaving, a girl carrying an enormous scythe steps forward from further inside.)
strings.메디아, 그건 내가 말할 때까지 쉿. 후후, 바보 같은 표정 짓는 %s하: Shh, Medea. Let me tell them. Hehe. Bring %s and that silly expression over here.
Shynic, I think I'm fine here...
strings.거기 바닥이 약해서 금방 부서져 떨어질걸?: The floor there is weak. It could break and drop you any second.
strings.어디로 흘러갈지 모르는 곳에서 죽어도 죽은 게 아니고 살아도 산 것도 아: But if you'd like to drift who knows where, neither truly alive nor truly dead, feel free to stay there. ♡
Huh? If she's being mischievous, then...
%s, save your shock for later. Look at Valdrick climbing up through the floor over there.
...Whew. The floor gave way. Thought I was going to die.
strings.여기 설계할 때 난 안 죽을 것 같아서 적당히 해뒀는데, 가끔 저러는 것: When I designed this place, I figured it couldn't kill me, so I cut a few corners. That happens sometimes.
strings.이제 저런 곳은 없으니까 걱정 마. 혼자서 타르타로스를 만든 날 의심하면: Don't worry. There aren't any more spots like that. You shouldn't doubt the girl who built Tartaros all by herself. ♡
Shynic, is this that place from long ago? When Adrica shook...?
strings.여기는 일종의 감옥. 날 저주에 물들인 그 영감에게 어떤 고통을 줄까 고: It's a sort of prison. I was thinking of ways to make the old man who cursed me suffer, and looking for somewhere to lock him up.
I went mad digging up the construction site and punched right through the Great Wall.
strings.여기다가 그 영감을 묻어버릴까 하다가 안 넣었어♡, 잘했지?: I considered burying him here, but I didn't. ♡ Aren't I good?
And thanks to that, you got to ▒▒ and ▒▒, which was even better.
strings.후후, 여기다가 가두면 영겁의 세월 속에 톱니바퀴처럼 고통받아 굴러가긴: Hehe. If I locked him up here, he'd turn like a cog through an eternity of suffering... But that wouldn't be fun.
strings.여기에 그 영감 얼굴이 있으면 나중에 이 장소를 꺼내는 게 힘들었을 거야: Besides, if his face were in here, it'd be hard to bring this place out again...
Anyway, there's something I've just taken back out, and someone to bury in here. Two birds with one stone. It would've been lovely if the flames were still burning, but they've all gone out.
Shynic, don't tell me the thing you took out is...
strings.메디아, 그거 너무 신경 쓰지 마. 내가 그걸 묻어둬서 내가 지금까지 제: Medea, don't worry about it. Burying that thing is the reason I've stayed sane all this time.
Well, if it's a se~cret, I suppose there's nothing I can do.
strings.걱정하지 마, 너한테 쓰진 않을 테니까♡: Don't worry. I won't use it on you. ♡
Shynic, if you really used that on %s... it would be fatal.
strings.그러게. 정말 죽겠네?: True. It really would kill you, wouldn't it?
strings.그렇게 안 할 거니까 걱정하지 마. 그리고 영감이 도와주고 있으니까 그럴: Don't worry. I won't do that. Besides, the old man's helping, so it won't come to that.
strings.드래곤 영감이 이곳이 무너지지 않게 지탱해 주고 있어. 아발론과 이곳,: The old dragon is holding this place together. Avalon, here, and the Debora Snowfields. He's incredible.
strings.그래서 일단 있는 힘을 다해 싸워야 해. 지금 이곳의 상황과 아발론의 상: So we need to give this fight everything we've got. We'll assess things here and in Avalon, then find Weiss.
strings.그러니까 잘 부탁해, %s. 모두를 위하고 생명을 위하고 여신님을 위한: I'm counting on you, %s. This is for everyone, for all life, and for the goddess.
strings.메디아의 자리는 고기 바보, 이오, 지스카드 아저씨 다음이야. 그곳에 서: Medea, your place is after the meathead, Io, and old Ziskad. Just stand there.
I'll take my place after I greet Lord Atkina.
Go on, %s. Say hello to everyone with Medea.
strings.저기 샤이닉 님, '자리'라는 게 있는 건가요?: Shynic, do we each have a 'place'?
strings.설명하기 복잡하니까 초인이 가진 그런 거라고 해둘게. 당연히 네 자리는: It's complicated to explain, so let's call it a Champion thing. Of course, you don't have one. ♡ If you want to become a Champion, you could kill one of...
strings.이해했어요. 이해할게요!: I get it! I'll get it!
Whew. Then I'll go see Lord Atkina! Let's go, Medea.
Hello, Valdrick. It's been a while.
You're younger than me, Medea. And %s is my little sibling, too. So that's what I'll call you both.
Very well. If that's what the Fierce King wishes...
What's this Fierce King nonsense? Call me Valdrick, or call me old man.
strings.그야 엄청 아저씨가 맞기는 하지만, 그래도 함부로 부를 수는…. 후우,: Well, you certainly are an old man, but I couldn't be so disrespectful... Sigh. Very well, Valdrick.
Good! Let's give it our best, little siblings!
Yes. I'm glad to have you with us.
strings.메디아 아우님이 결심해준 덕분에 그 나쁜 놈이 더 나쁜 놈을 부르는 걸: Thanks to your decision, little sister Medea, we've delayed that bad guy summoning an even worse guy.
A bad guy and an even worse guy...
strings.(이해가 되는 게 신비한 화법이라니까….): (It's amazing how much sense he makes...)
I only did what I had to do.
There's still much to do. Let's prepare here before we leave.
strings.좋아, 좋아. 오랜만에 다같이 날뛰어 보자고!: Good, good! It's been ages since we all cut loose together!
strings.그래, 내가 제대로 바이스 놈 때려 잡을게!!: I'll give that Weiss a proper beating!!
You two, if you have a moment, how about sparring with...
strings.발드릭, 나중에 다른 대륙에서 좋은 고기를 가져다 드릴게요. 그러면 저하: Valdrick, I'll bring you some fine meat from another continent sometime. Medea and I are going to see Lord Atkina now.
strings.뭐? 다른 대륙의 고기라니!! 아우님 정말 멋져!! 기대할게!: What?! Meat from another continent?! You're the best, little sibling!! I can't wait!
strings.(순순히 보내주는 발드릭의 모습에 메디아가 놀란 듯 %s의 얼굴을 바라본: (Surprised at how readily Valdrick lets them leave, Medea looks at %s.)
Brilliant, %s... I'm impres... Never mind. Let's go.
We only saw each other recently, and you're asking already? Hehe.
You needn't thank me, Lady Io. It's what I must...
That's true for us, too. So don't worry about anything else right now. Understood?
strings.(이오가 메디아의 대답에 만족했는지 환한 미소를 보인다.): (Apparently satisfied with Medea's answer, Io smiles brightly.)
strings.아, 맞다. %s…. [불타는 수레바퀴]에 대한 설명 들었어?: Oh, that's right. %s... Have you heard about the [Burning Wheel]?
Really? I suppose it wouldn't hurt to explain it again...
strings.여기는 우리의 세계, 그리고 다른 이들의 세계 사이의 경계야. 중간 장소: This is the boundary between our world and other people's worlds. Think of it as a place in between.
strings.이리스 님께서 성계신이라 하더라도 모든 세계를 알 수 없어. 이제 우리의: Even as the God of the Astral Realm, Lady Iris cannot know every world. She's only just come to know our own, Eastland...
strings.여기는 이리스 님의 영향을 벗어난 영역이야. 그래서 정신적으로 연결된 네: This place lies beyond her influence. That's why you, with your mental connection to her, must learn as much as you can.
strings.그리고 아발론도 마찬가지야. 이스트랜드에 있는 장소지만, 바이스가 불러온: The same goes for Avalon. It's in Eastland, but power from another world summoned by Weiss has corrupted it. Lady Iris can't perceive it at all.
strings.잘 모르겠다는 표정인 것 같은데…?: You don't look like you do...
How could I not, with you explaining it so well?
Oh, %s... Such a smooth talker. You really are something.
Lady Io, we'll go see Lord Atkina now.
strings.저기 메디아 양? 샤이닉 언니는 샤이닉이면서 왜 나는 이오 님이야?: Wait, Medea? You call Shynic by her name. Why am I 'Lady Io'?
What would you like her to call you, Io?
strings.말도 편하게 하고, 이왕이면 이오 언니?: She could speak casually, and perhaps call me big sister Io?
strings.마을엔 몇백 년이나 어린 동생들밖에 없어서 나이 차이 많이 나지 않는 그: Everyone in the village is hundreds of years younger than me. I'd like a little sister closer to my own age.
W-well, the age gap between us isn't exactly small, Lady Io...
M-Medea? I'm joking. Just joking! Don't be so nervous.
I'll go say hello to Ziskad and Lord Atkina.
I'll be going as well, Lady Io.
All right. We have plenty of time to talk later.
I wasn't expecting you and Medea together, %s. That makes this an even nicer surprise.
It's been a while. I'm sorry for what happened at your estate.
It's all right. You must have had a great deal on your mind.
strings.어라, 영지에 가신 적이 있나요, 메디아 님?: Oh? You visited his estate, Medea?
strings.내게 볼일이 있어서 잠깐 왔다 갔다네. %s, 자네 불타는 수레바퀴에 대: She had some business with me and stopped by. %s, have you heard about the Burning Wheel?
strings.네, 들었어요. 지금 아발론의 상태에 관해 이야기해주실 수 있나요?: Yes. Could you tell me what's happening in Avalon?
strings.아발론은 지금 아무도 없네. 정확히 이야기하자면 우리 세계의 생명력을 지: There's no one there now. To be precise, no one possessing the life force of our world.
strings.아발론에 있는 모든 생명체는 이미 속박의 힘으로 환원된 것 같더군. 그래: It seems every living creature in Avalon has already been reduced to the power of binding. That's why I said there's nothing there.
strings.바이스는 자신이 이용했던 모든 생명, 자신을 제외한 모든 걸 그 힘으로: Weiss seems to have converted every life he used, everything except himself, into that power.
strings.그에게 세뇌되어 그를 따르던 부하들과 악마와 마족들마저 사라져 그의 힘이: Even the followers he brainwashed, the demons and fiends, have vanished and become his strength...
strings.아발론을 돌아다니는 존재들은 바이스와는 상관없이 이 세계의 멸망을 바라며: The beings roaming Avalon are merely remnants that wish for this world's destruction, regardless of Weiss.
Think of them as monsters from another world, %s.
strings.바이스는 뭘 어떻게 하려는 걸까요?: What is Weiss trying to do?
strings.아발론을 자신이 알고 있는 세계처럼 다른 공간으로 만들어냈네. 그건 아마: He's made Avalon into a different space, resembling a world he knows. Most likely...
Yes. We cannot know what will happen, but Deimos will be at its center.
That's why we're all here. Including you...
strings.지금 프로즌과 렌이 순찰하고 있지. 뭔가 알아내면 알려준다고 했으니 그동: Frozen and Ren are patrolling now. They promised to tell us if they discover anything. In the meantime, go greet Lord Atkina.
strings.네, 그럴게요. 그런데 저기 있는 건…. 거대한 드래곤? 저렇게 큰데,: I will. But over there... Is that a giant dragon? How did I miss something so huge?
You can see the dragon now? That's Lord Atkina.
You're growing accustomed to this space, %s. That's why you can see him now.
strings.(아드키나가 %s에게 무슨 말을 하는 것 같다.): (Atkina seems to be saying something to %s.)
strings.(하지만, 아드키나의 음성에 알 수 없는 힘이 실려 귀를 찌른다.): (But an unknown power carried in his voice pierces their ears.)
Ziskad, we'd better hurry over to Lord Atkina.
Yes. Get them there quickly so it can be settled.
Ugh, all right... See you later, Ziskad.
strings.(보석처럼 빛나는 눈을 가진 거대한 드래곤이 불타는 수레바퀴 안쪽에 앉아: (A gigantic dragon with jewel-bright eyes sits deep within the Burning Wheel, watching a path that leads somewhere beyond.)
strings.(그러다 자신에게로 오는 두 사람의 모습을 보고 시선을 돌린다.): (Seeing the two approach, he turns his gaze toward them.)
It's been a while, Lord Atkina.
Aaaah! Lord Atkina! My ears feel like they're tearing apart! It hurts!
strings.(아드키나가 그제야 알았다는 듯 고개를 끄덕인다. 잠시 후, 그가 입을: (Atkina nods in sudden understanding. When he speaks again, the force bearing down on %s vanishes.)
strings.미안하네. 이 모습으로 누군가와 대화하는 건 오랜만이라 제어한다는 걸 잊: I'm sorry. It's been so long since I spoke to anyone in this form that I forgot to control it.
strings.샤이닉, 지스카드, 발드릭, 이오가 아무렇지도 않아서 그대도 괜찮을 줄: Shynic, Ziskad, Valdrick, and Io were unaffected. I assumed you would be, too.
That I'd been waiting, and was glad to see you.
strings.그대가 지금 듣고 있는 건 고대 플루톤 드래곤의 언어, 용언(龍言)…이라: What you hear is the language of the ancient Pluton dragons. We call it Dragon Speech.
With a little adjustment, I've made it possible for you to hear my words.
strings.고대 시절, 플루톤 드래곤은 다른 불경한 자들이 우리의 이야기를 듣지 않: Long ago, the Pluton dragons pooled their power to conceal their speech from the ears of the unworthy.
Think of it as a kind of encoded signal.
strings.그렇게 세레스 님과 세레스 님께서 허락한 이들만 들을 수 있네. 그대도: Only Lady Seres and those she permits can hear it. You can because you are with Lady Iris.
Otherwise, listening to it any longer might have shattered your mind.
strings.하하, 그대도…. 메디아, 그대는 괜찮은가?: Haha. Indeed... Medea, are you all right?
I wasn't asking about Dragon Speech...
In that case, you needn't worry.
strings.그러면 전 제 자리로 가보겠습니다. 그럼 %s, 아드키나 님과 말씀 나누: Then I'll take my place. %s, I'll leave you to speak with Lord Atkina.
strings.(메디아가 인사를 하고 물러나자 아드키나가 조용히 고개를 들어 허공을 바: (As Medea says farewell and leaves, Atkina quietly lifts his head and looks into the air.)
strings.아발론에 문이 열렸네. 바이스가 만든 문이 열려서 다른 세계의 힘이 흘러: A door has opened in Avalon. The door Weiss made is letting power from another world flow through.
strings.지금 그대는 느껴지지 않겠지만, 위대한 벽과 가까이 있는 내겐 그게 느껴: You may not feel it yet, but I can, so close to the Great Wall.
strings.아발론으로 가는 문을 통해 프로즌과 렌을 찾게. 지금 이 일 때문에 이: Go through the door to Avalon and find Frozen and Ren. With this happening, they won't be able to return here.
strings.데보라 설원까지 속박의 힘이 흘러들어오지 않게 내가 이곳을 지키고 있으니: I'm guarding this place so the power of binding doesn't reach the Debora Snowfields. Don't worry too much about us.
strings.나를 제외한 나머지 일행은 이곳의 일이 끝나면 바로 바이스를 찾으러 갈: Once their work here is finished, the others will go after Weiss. I'll remain. Don't push yourself; find Frozen and stay with him.
The goddess is working to keep the wall from collapsing, too. We must all see this through.
strings.(드래곤 아드키나의 표정이 제대로 보이진 않지만, 아드키나 특유의 너그러: (It is difficult to read the dragon's expression, but Atkina's familiar, kindly smile comes through.)
strings.(저 문으로 가면 되는 건가? 밖에서 불길한 힘이 느껴져….): (Through that door, then? I can feel something sinister outside...)
strings.(%s의 모습이 불타는 수레바퀴에서 사라지자 저 멀리서 샤이닉이 빠른 속: (As %s disappears from the Burning Wheel, Shynic comes racing over from afar.)
strings.영감!! 밖에 무슨 일 있는 거 맞지?!: Old man!! Something's happening outside, isn't it?!
strings.(그러다 바닥에 있는 바퀴에 걸렸는지 넘어진다.): (She trips, apparently catching her foot on a wheel on the floor.)
I keep telling you to be careful. You'll fall if you run like that...
strings.나 애 아냐! 괜찮아! 아니…. 나 정말 괜찮은 걸까?: I'm not a child! I'm fine! No... Am I really fine?
Don't worry. You have done nothing wrong. None of it was your fault to begin with.
strings.그동안 용서받고 싶어서 별일을 다 했는데, 다들 죽어버려서 용서받지도: I've done all sorts of things, wanting to be forgiven. But everyone died, so no one could forgive me. Sigh... Nothing to be done about that...
strings.그래서 아무에게도 용서받지 않아도 되는 일을 만들 거야. 괜찮지?♡: So now I'm going to do something I won't need anyone's forgiveness for. That's all right, isn't it? ♡
strings.(어두웠던 곳을 지나 도착한 곳에서 불타는 수레바퀴와는 다른 이스트랜드의: (Beyond the dark passage lies the familiar air of Eastland, unlike the Burning Wheel.)
It looks just like the vision I saw before coming here.
strings.(자욱한 모래 안개 사이로 거대한 도시에 세워졌던 것 같은 건축물과 주택: (Through the thick sandy haze, buildings and homes suggest what must once have been an enormous city.)
strings.정말 지금 아무것도 없는 걸까?: Is there really nothing here now?
I-it's suffocating. I can still move, but this...
Lord Atkina said to find Frozen and someone named Ren. I'd better hurry.
But which way? This place is enormous. I need to know where they are...
strings.(그런 그때, 어디선가 어떤 여성의 기합 소리가 들려온다.): (Just then, a woman's battle cry rings out from somewhere nearby.)
I'm not sure where she is, but I'd better hurry. She could be in danger...
strings.(아발론의 막다른 골목, 배틀로드 복장의 한 여성이 몬스터로 보이는 존재: (In an Avalonian dead end, a woman dressed as a Battle Lord is surrounded by monstrous beings.)
strings.여기까지 몰고 오느라 힘들었다. 으차. 저는 여러분이 이스트랜드의 생명이: Phew! Herding you all the way here was hard work. I've confirmed that none of you are living creatures of Eastland. In that case...!
strings.(여성이 말을 끝내자마자 검집에서 검을 꺼내 휘두른다. 그러자 눈 앞에: (As soon as she finishes speaking, she draws and swings her sword. A wave of sword energy annihilates the otherworldly beings before her.)
strings.까, 깜짝 놀랐어요! 언제부터 거기 서 있으셨어요?: Y-you startled me! How long have you been standing there?
strings.혹시 %s 님? 스승님께 이야기 들었어요. 렌 님~ 말고 편하게 렌이라: Are you %s? My master told me about you. Please, just call me Ren. It's nice to meet you.
strings.(수도사 출신이면서 검신의 제자라…. 특이한 이력이네.): (A former temple ascetic who's also the Sword Master's disciple... An unusual background.)
You must be wondering why I wield a sword instead of a magic rod.
The thought did cross my mind.
strings.저는 원래 신전의 수도사였지만, 사정이 있어서 이스트랜드로 왔다가 스승님: I was originally an ascetic at the temple, but circumstances brought me to Eastland. There I met my master and became his disciple.
strings.제가 있는 곳까지 오시면서 공격받으시진 않았나요? 조금 지치신 것 같은데: Were you attacked on your way here? You look a little tired...
A little, but I'm all right.
strings.아니에요. 안 괜찮으니까, 잠깐 뒤돌아주시겠어요?: No, you're not. Could you turn around for a moment?
strings.네? 아, 네…. 그런데 검을 왜 저를 향해서?!: Hm? Oh, all right... Wait, why are you pointing your sword at me?!
strings.(렌이 검집에서 꺼낸 검이 %s의 등쪽을 스쳐 지나간다.): (Ren draws her sword and sweeps it across %s's back.)
Huh? It doesn't hurt at all. I actually feel lighter.
I'm glad. That's what my sword does.
strings.유란 언니나 울과 엘과는 조금 다른 스타일이죠. 제 신력은 오직 검에서만: My style is a little different from Yuran's, or Ull and Ell's. My divine power manifests only through my sword.
That's incredible. Just as I'd expect...
strings.이곳에서 컨디션이 안 좋은 것 같다 느껴지시면 바로 저에게 오세요. 최대: If you feel unwell while you're here, come straight to me. I'll give you as thorough a slashing as I can.
Ahaha... I'll be sure to take care of myself.
strings.아, 그러면 렌…, 지금 이곳의 상황은 어떤가요? 아드키나 님 말씀으로는: So, Ren... What's happening here? Lord Atkina said a door had opened in Avalon.
Oh, that must be what Frozen meant.
strings.프로즌 님께서 저 안쪽에서 불길한 힘이 느껴지신다면서 이곳에서 기다리라고: He said he sensed something sinister further inside and told me to wait here.
I think he went to find that door...
The sinister beings in Avalon have been increasing in number.
strings.아드키나 님께서 말씀하신 그 문은 어쩌면 다른 곳으로 가는 또 다른 차원: Perhaps the door Lord Atkina mentioned connects to another dimension, leading somewhere else.
strings.바이스가 만든 거겠죠?: Weiss must have made it, right?
strings.알고 계시듯이 바이스가 부르려는 데이모스…. 준비가 거의 끝난 것처럼 보: As you know, Weiss is trying to summon Deimos... The preparations seem almost complete, but something is missing.
strings.그게 뭔지는 모르겠어요. 아발론에는 그가 원하는 게 하나도 없거든요. 그: I don't know what. There's nothing he wants here in Avalon. Only unknown enemies who have come to ruin our world.
strings.문으로 보이는 곳이 여러 개가 있는 것 같아요. 어…?: There seem to be several things that look like doors. Huh...?
That sinister presence is growing stronger. 'Evil' isn't quite the right word for it...
I don't know where Frozen is, but we need to find him quickly.
I'll guard you. Visibility is poor ahead, so be careful.
strings.이 어리석은 자여. 네 믿음을 던진 채 향한 곳이 겨우 이곳이었느냐. 네: You fool! You cast aside your faith only to end up here? Is this the answer you wanted?!
If this is the path you've chosen...
strings.(프로즌이 좀처럼 흥분을 감추지 못하자 그의 어깨에 있던 정령이 그를 맴: (Unable to contain his agitation, Frozen is circled by the spirit from his shoulder.)
Sorry, Ruu. I got worked up again, didn't I? I'll try to stay calm.
strings.(그제야 루우라 이름 불린 정령이 다시 프로즌의 어깨로 되돌아간다.): (Only then does the spirit called Ruu return to Frozen's shoulder.)
strings.%s도 왔군. 여기까지 오는데 별일 없었어?: You're here too, %s. Did you have any trouble on the way?
strings.저는 괜찮은데, 프로즌 님, 괜찮으세요?: I'm fine, but are you all right, Frozen?
I'm glad nothing happened to you.
strings.%s, 저쪽에서 이질적인 힘이 느껴지지?: %s, can you feel that alien power coming from over there?
strings.네, 조금…. 혹시 저쪽에 그 문이란 게 있나요?: Yes, a little... Is that where the door is?
strings.수상한 두 개의 문이 있어. 하나는 책으로 됐고, 하나는 그냥 일반 문의: There are two strange doors. One takes the form of a book, the other looks like an ordinary door. Both seem to lead to spaces in other worlds.
strings.내가 두 개의 문을 다 살펴봤지만, 책으로 된 문에만 들어갈 수 있는 걸: I examined both, but I could only enter the book-shaped door.
strings.반쯤 열려 있긴 하지만, 거기서 흘러나오는 다른 세계의 기운 때문에 들어: It's half open, but the otherworldly energy pouring out kept me from entering.
If we could weaken it a little, we might manage...
strings.어때? %s, 해볼래?: What do you say, %s? Want to try?
Good. Together, we can solve this. My suggestion is holy power.
strings.책으로 보이는 문 저편에 신성력이 남아있어. 그곳의 신성력을 이용하면 반: Some remains beyond the door that looks like a book. We can use it to enter the half-open door.
Wait, Frozen. If there's holy power...
The man who doubted our god is there.
When a follower of a god loses faith and begins to doubt, their power changes drastically. And Belosh became intoxicated by the power of 'Binding,' until even his mind gave way.
My abilities didn't work on him.
strings.벨로쉬가 신전에서 나가면서 자신을 말리는 수도사들을 쓰러뜨렸어. 렌을 비: When Belosh left the temple, he struck down the ascetics who tried to stop him. Only a few survived, including Ren.
I think I need to meet him.
strings.너는 내가 기다리라고 했던 원래 자리로 돌아가. 거기서 적들이 수레바퀴: Go back to where I told you to wait. Keep the enemies from approaching the Wheel.
strings.이곳의 존재들은 널 쉽게 건드릴 수 없어. 그러니까 날 믿고, 널 믿고,: The beings here can't easily harm you. Trust me, trust yourself, and trust everyone. Just as you always have.
Hold them off until everyone except Lord Atkina comes out.
strings.네, 프로즌 님. 저는 바로 왔던 곳으로 돌아갈게요. %s 님, 프로즌: Yes, Frozen. I'll head back now. %s, please take care of him.
strings.(렌이 알았다는 듯이 고개를 끄덕이고 다시 왔던 길로 되돌아간다. 렌이: (Ren nods and returns the way she came. Once she is gone, Frozen pats %s on the shoulder.)
They have plans of their own. We can ask them later.
strings.(벨로쉬…, 왜 그 사람은 이리스를 믿지 않았던 걸까…. 그리고 왜 이곳: (Belosh... Why didn't he believe in Iris? And why is he here...?)
strings.(거대한 책 사이로 보이는 빛을 따라 들어간 곳은 황량한 아발론과는 달리: (Following the light between the pages of an enormous book, they enter a place filled with warm light, unlike desolate Avalon.)
strings.(내려오는 빛 아래로 많은 나무, 외벽에 설치된 책장, 그리고 그 책장에: (In the descending light, they see trees and bookshelves lining the outer walls, filled with countless books.)
strings.이런 곳이 있었군. 말로만 들었었는데…. %s, 함부로 손대면 안 될 것: So this place really exists. I'd only heard of it... %s, I don't think we should touch anything carelessly. Be careful.
strings.네, 그럴게요. 그런데 이곳에 대해 알고 계세요?: I will. Do you know this place?
strings.교단의 중심에는 교리 그 자체인 성서가 있어. 해석에 따라 다른 면을 보: At the heart of our order is scripture, the doctrine itself. Its different interpretations reveal different aspects, just as one place can contain many different things...
strings.교단의 고위급 관계자들에게만 내려오는 해석이 있는데…. 위대한 벽을 넘: There's an interpretation passed down only to the order's senior members... It speaks of a place beyond the Great Wall that records information about every world.
strings.그런데, 이렇게 그 정보가 이런 식으로 책으로 표현되다니…. 생각지도 못: But I never imagined that information would take the form of books like this...
It's no wonder Belosh came here.
It feels like a sacred temple.
strings.%s, 이곳에 우리의 신은 없으니 조심해야 해. 마치 누군가 이곳에 신: %s, our god isn't here. Be careful. It feels as though someone deliberately scattered this holy aura throughout the place.
strings.(프로즌이 앞으로 나와 어디선가 날아오는 갈고리 공격을 받아친다. 한 번: (Frozen steps forward and deflects a hook flying toward them. More attacks follow, but every one proves useless against him.)
That fool took every hit, but a Demigod sees right through them.
I'm fine. I take it you've met Baral before.
strings.얼마 안된 것 같은데, 한 1년은 지난 것 기분이네. 아발론에서 보자고: Doesn't seem that long ago, but it feels like a year. I said we'd meet in Avalon, but I didn't expect this. Good to see you, fool.
strings.바랄, 넌 대체 여기서 뭘 하고 있는 거지?: Baral, what are you doing here?
strings.계약에 따라 뭘 찾았던 것뿐이다. 갑자기 너희가 들어와서 좀 놀랐지. 아: Looking for something, as my contract requires. I was a little surprised when you suddenly arrived. Or perhaps I should have expected it?
strings.바이스가 신성한 가호를 받은 자만 들어올 수 있는 공간이라고 했어. 그리: Weiss said only those with divine protection could enter this place. He also said its holiness was a disguise.
Vanitas... was that the name? Weiss said it was a good place to rest...
strings.이름은 중요하지 않다. 바이스가 초인의 힘을 가진 존재여서 이곳에 들어왔: The name doesn't matter. Weiss has the power of a Champion, which explains how he entered. But how did you get in?
Since the noble Demigod asks, I'll answer.
strings.정령왕의 약이 효과가 있던 모양이군. 엘리시온의 동생이 가지고 있던 걸: The Spirit King's potion seems to work. I drank what Elysion's little sister had, and now I can enter the Demon Realm and other worlds.
strings.(엘리시온이면 엘의 오빠 이름…. 그리고 그 약은….): (Elysion is Ell's brother... And that potion...)
strings.이걸로 바이스에게서 얻어낸 것도 있고. 다른 고용주에게도 받아낼 것도 많: I've gotten something out of Weiss with it, too. Other employers owe me plenty as well... No time to chat. I'm leaving.
strings.그건 그렇고 지금 너희들이 찾는 게 나하고 같은 건가? 그러면 누가 먼저: By the way, are you looking for what I'm looking for? Then let's see who finds it first!
strings.불경한 데미갓 녀석의 정신이 붕괴하기 전에 !!: Before that impious Demigod's mind collapses!!
(Having said his piece, Baral turns and disappears without a trace.)
strings.%s, 잘 들어. 벨로쉬를 끝내는 건 우리가 해야 해. 우리는 그 힘이: Listen carefully, %s. We must be the ones to finish Belosh. We need that power. We must reclaim what belongs to our god.
If Baral takes it, he'll put it to some twisted use...
strings.이거 길이 복잡해 보이네. 바랄이 가운데로 간 것 같으니까 우리는 나눠서: The paths look complicated. Baral seems to have gone down the middle, so we'll have to split up.
strings.어떤 길이라도 벨로쉬가 발견되거나 무슨 일이 일어나면 루우가 바로 알려줄: Whichever path we're on, Ruu will tell us at once if we find Belosh or something happens. Your energy is affecting Ruu now, too.
strings.(프로즌이 어깨 위에 있는 정령을 들어 보여준다. 그러자 정령 루우가 인: (Frozen lifts the spirit from his shoulder. Ruu meets their eyes and smiles in greeting.)
I'm counting on you, little spirit.
%s, take that way. I'll go this way. Come on, Ruu.
There are things I want to ask Belosh. I'd better find him quickly...
strings.(하얀 공간에 세워진 나무와 책장 사이에 있는 길이 끝없이 이어진다. 그: (A path stretches endlessly between trees and bookshelves in the white space. Somewhere along it, an eerie purple light spills out.)
What's this light? It feels like someone is deliberately spreading it...
strings.(강력하고도 불길한 기운이 순식간에 폭발하면서 벽에 세워져 있던 거대한: (A powerful, ominous force suddenly erupts, shattering the enormous bookshelves along the walls.)
strings.(그 안에서 보라색으로 물든 갑옷을 입은 남자가 천천히 걸어 나온다. 뒤: (A man in purple-stained armor walks slowly from the wreckage. Baral pursues him and hurls a chain, which the man casually knocks aside with his arm.)
strings.젠장!! 또 튕겨내? 왜? 왜! 한 번도 통하지 않는 거야? 그 멍청이랑: Damn it! Deflected again?! Why?! Why doesn't it work even once?! It works fine on that fool and everyone else!
Such feeble attacks cannot even scratch me...
strings.벨로쉬, 빨리 덤벼! 제대로 상대해 주지!!: Belosh! Come on, fight me properly!
To hear my name from the mouth of a wretch like you...
strings.(벨로쉬라고 불린 자가 부서진 매직로드를 들자 주위에 거대한 폭발이 일어: (The man called Belosh raises a broken magic rod, triggering a tremendous explosion.)
All talk, aren't you? Some Demigod you are...
strings.(바랄의 주위에 있던 책장이 무너지고, 그 뒤로 숨겨져 있던 수상한 검은: (A bookshelf near Baral collapses, revealing a strange black hole hidden behind it.)
Farewell. Never set foot in this world again.
strings.(말이 끝나기가 무섭게 벨로쉬가 일으킨 폭발이 또 다시 이어진다. 그 충: (No sooner has Belosh spoken than another explosion erupts. The impact sends Baral into the black hole, where he vanishes.)
strings.(로젠가르텐에서 봤던 그 검은 구멍이야. 시공간의 틈…이라고 했었어.): (It's the same black hole I saw in Rosengarten. They called it a rift in spacetime...)
strings.언제부터 거기 있었지? 바이스가 보낸 방해자인가?: How long have you been there? Did Weiss send you to interfere?
You! You!! You feel just like that woman.
The one Lady Seres sought to raise as her successor... Disgusting...
What are you talking about? You're a Demigod, a servant of a god. Iris has succeeded Lady Seres...
strings.닥쳐라!! 그 여자가 무슨 신이냐?! 그 약해 빠진 여자가?!: Silence!! That woman, a god?! That weakling?!
strings.그러고 보니 네 놈은 그 여자가 계속해서 이야기하던 녀석인가? 한 번도: Wait. Are you the one she was always talking about? How does it make sense to wait for someone she's never even seen?
strings.(벨로쉬가 짜증나는 것 같은 표정으로 %s의 얼굴을 바라본다.): (Belosh stares at %s with an irritated expression.)
strings.대체 왜? 왜 그 여자가 신이 된 거지? 젠장…. 신에게 선택받은 인간이: Why? Why did she become a god? Damn it... A human chosen by a god becomes one? An ordinary, useless human with no power!
strings.같은 신이 만든 인간인데, 조금 다를 뿐인 일족의 계집아이면서 왜?!: A human created by the same god, just a girl from a slightly different tribe. Why her?!
How does that make sense? A god should awaken with innate omnipotence.
strings.(바보토스…. 아니, 바르바토스가 이야기했던 그 말이 떠오르네. 신이라면: (That reminds me of what Dummytos... no, Barbatos said. He looked down on Iris and Lady Gaia, saying gods should have power worthy of the name.)
strings.하하하, 하하하하하. 신이란 존재는 정말 멋대로네. 너 같은 인간을 편애: Hahaha! Hahahahaha! Gods truly do as they please. Favoring a human like you, handing out protection on a whim.
Lady Seres, Lady Gaia, and that woman... Every god does whatever they please! Aaaaargh!!
strings.(벨로쉬가 분노하듯 소리를 지르자 주위를 감싸고 있던 불길한 기운이 요동: (As Belosh roars in rage, the sinister energy around him surges.)
If you truly bear a god's protection, you should be able to defeat the mighty Belosh. Kill me if you wish to prove yourself. Otherwise, you will die.
But you won't kill me easily. I am...
strings.나는!! 모두가 우러러보는 신의 사도!! 데미갓 벨로쉬다!!: I am Belosh, the Demigod! An apostle of a god, revered by all!!
strings.내 신성력…? 하하하, 하하하하하. 결국 날 죽이려고 온 거면서!! 그: My holy power...? Hahaha! Hahahahaha! So you did come to kill me! Did that woman order you to?!
strings.그 여자가 원하는 대로 되지 않을 거야. 너는 이 자리에서 피를 흘리고: She won't get what she wants. You'll bleed and die right here...
(With a look of disgust, Belosh gathers unholy energy in his broken magic rod.)
There's no reasoning with you anymore. Do I have any choice...?
strings.이곳을 네 피로 물들여 주지. 가짜 신의 사도여!!: I'll stain this place with your blood, apostle of a false god!
Hah... hah... You're no ordinary opponent.
strings.(오랜 전투 끝에 벨로쉬가 뒤로 물러나 %s의 상태를 지켜본다.): (After a long battle, Belosh retreats and assesses %s's condition.)
strings.하아, 하아…. 벨로쉬. 다시 한 번 말하지만 나는 당신을 죽이려고 온: Hah... hah... Belosh. I'll say it again. I didn't come to kill you. To reach Weiss, we need to enter another door, and that requires holy power. So...
The fight isn't over. You talk too much...
strings.(벨로쉬가 벽을 두드리자 바니타스의 외벽이 갈라진다. 그 영향으로 조금: (Belosh strikes the wall, cracking Vanitas's outer shell. The black hole that swallowed Baral begins to widen.)
strings.그만 해!! 안 그러면 모두가 저 틈으로 빠지고 만다고!: Stop! You'll send us all into that rift!
Then I'll give you the answer you seek.
strings.교단은 내가 다른 의문을 품는 걸 허락하지 않았다. 내가 속박의 힘에 취: The order wouldn't allow me to question anything. They forcibly confined me, saying I was drunk on the power of binding, that my mind had collapsed.
strings.젠장, 내 힘으로 구원했던 세계가 날 이런 취급을 해? 내가 자만했다고?: Damn it! I saved this world with my power, and this is how it treats me? I'm arrogant? They dare condemn me? I was freed from that damned binding! I'm not drunk on it!
strings.이건 내 잘못이 아냐. 그 여자가 신이란 운명을 받아들이면서 이 세계를: This isn't my fault. That woman accepted her destiny as a god and ruined this world!
And if I don't, what will you do? Hahahaha!
strings.나는 이곳에서 진리를 깨달았다. 신의 모험가같이 모순된 존재가 알 필요도: Here, I have learned the truth. A truth a contradiction like the god's adventurer need never know...
strings.(벨로쉬가 부서진 매직로드를 들어 %s를 향해 든 순간, 갑자기 그가 그: (Belosh raises his broken magic rod toward %s, then suddenly collapses to the floor.)
So the apostle has done what he was told not to, just like the other one.
Struggle all you like, foolish Demigod.
strings.그 진리를 깨우치면 이곳에서 나갈 수 있을 거라 생각한 건가…. 이 바니: Did you think learning that truth would let you leave...? You believed you could survive by becoming the god of this Vanitas.
strings.어차피 이곳은 연옥을 위해 사라질 공간…. 삶과 죽음의 경계의 선이 닿을: This place is destined to vanish for Purgatory... When the boundaries of life and death meet, it will lead to Azrael.
strings.이곳은 아즈라엘만의 바니타스…. 다른 세계의 바니타스는 필요없다. 아즈라: This is Azrael's Vanitas alone... I have no need for another world's Vanitas. Azrael's truth will descend here...
strings.(바이스가 안쪽에 열린 시공간의 틈을 향해 외친다.): (Weiss shouts toward the rift in spacetime further inside.)
Weiss, who are you talking to? What is...
Oathbreaker, you who sent me here...
I offer you the product of your failed design.
strings.반에 이어 벨로쉬까지…. 이왕이면 럭스도 처리하면 좋았을텐데…. 시간이: First Ban, now Belosh... I would have liked to dispose of Lux as well... But there was too little time...
strings.(바니타스 외벽에 있던 검은 구멍 속에서 수상한 힘이 흘러나온다. 그 힘: (An eerie force spills from the black hole in Vanitas's outer wall. It forms black arms that seize Belosh's limbs and head.)
I will not... be devoured... by such... sinister power... Gaaah...
strings.(검은 구멍에서 흘러나온 검은 팔들이 커다란 어둠으로 변해 어리석은 데미: (The black arms become a vast darkness that swallows the foolish Demigod completely, leaving no trace.)
%s... You have nothing left to do here.
strings.어리석은 데미갓이 가지고 있던 신성력은 너와 함께 온 다른 데미갓에게 보: I sent the foolish Demigod's holy power to the other Demigod who accompanied you. He's still wandering around...
I only brought that Demigod here to buy a little time...
strings.나는 벨로쉬에게 제대로 된 대답을 듣지 못했어!!: I never got a proper answer from Belosh!!
strings.(바이스는 가소롭다는 표정으로 분노한 %s의 공격을 튕겨낸다.): (With a contemptuous look, Weiss deflects %s's furious attack.)
strings.이렇게 무너지는 바니타스에서 시간을 보내는 건 무의미하다…. 이제 연옥이: Lingering in this collapsing Vanitas is pointless... Purgatory will open now, and his power will descend.
strings.어떤 선택을 해도, 네가 원하는 결과는 나오지 않을 테니, 너무 무리하지: Whatever you choose, you will not get the outcome you desire. I suggest you don't overexert yourself...
strings.(바이스의 말과 함께 바니타스의 외벽과 바닥이 갈라지기 시작한다. 흔들리: (As Weiss speaks, Vanitas's walls and floor begin to split. In the trembling space, the two slowly lose sight of one another.)
Weiss, wait for me there. I will...
Oh, Ruu? Frozen? Is he all right? He's over there? Let's go...
strings.(멀리 %s의 모습이 사라지는 걸 확인한 바이스가 자신의 뒤로 기진맥진한: (Once %s has vanished into the distance, Weiss addresses an exhausted figure clambering up behind him.)
I nearly died, thanks to you.
strings.오늘의 끝이 어떻든 간에 약속한 대로 살려주지. 덕분에 위약자에게 내 메: Whatever happens at the end of this day, I will spare you as promised. You helped deliver my message to the Oathbreaker.
strings.거 참 고맙군. 열심히 일했으니 자유다 이건가?: How very generous. I've worked hard, so now I'm free?
You may work for Daphne now.
strings.그 마녀 이름을 바이스 입에서 들으니 소름 끼치는 걸…. 그런데 하나: Hearing that witch's name from you gives me the creeps... But there's something I want to ask.
strings.여기 말고 아발론 끝에 문 하나 세워져 있잖아. 그 안에 서 있던, 네: There's another door at the far end of Avalon. What was that thing standing inside, wearing your face?
strings.(정령 루우가 책장 사이의 길을 찾아주면서 바니타스의 모습이 천천히 사라: (Ruu guides them through the bookshelves. Vanitas slowly fades, and Avalon comes into view.)
strings.(여전히 바니타스의 입구로 보이는 거대한 책이 남아있지만, 들어가기 전과: (The enormous book that serves as Vanitas's entrance remains, but it feels different now.)
strings.다시 들어갈 수 있는 건가? 아니야, 지금은 다시 들어가면 안 돼. 프로: Can I still go in? No. I shouldn't go back now. Frozen? Where are you?
strings.(손을 흔드는 프로즌의 모습이 보인다. 루우가 프로즌을 보더니 환하게 웃: (Frozen comes into view, waving. Ruu beams at the sight of him and flies over.)
strings.그보다… 벨로쉬는 죽었지? 아니, 사라진 건가?: More to the point... Belosh is dead, isn't he? Or should I say, gone?
strings.(프로즌에게 벨로쉬를 만나 일어났던 일에 관해 이야기한다.): (You tell Frozen what happened when you met Belosh.)
strings.%s, 말하고 싶은 게 있는데, 해도 될까?: %s, there's something I'd like to tell you. May I?
My task was to escort Lady Iris from our order's temple to Lumen. I intended to return to Freios when it was done...
strings.데이모스 교단의 일이 커지면서 아발론을 계속 주시했고, 잠입을 시도하면서: But as the Deimos cult's activities escalated, I kept watch on Avalon. My attempts to infiltrate it taught me a great deal. Then a new mission arrived from the order.
strings.내 손으로 그를 단죄하라는…. 벨로쉬의 오만과 신을 향한 의심이 계속됐지: To pass judgment on him myself... Belosh's arrogance and doubt toward our god continued, though I thought they would end eventually...
strings.안타깝게 생각하지 않아도 돼. 내 손으로 끝내지 않은 걸 불행 중 다행이: You needn't pity me. Perhaps not having to end him with my own hands was a blessing amid the misfortune... Sigh...
strings.어쨌든 벨로쉬가 가진 오염되지 않은 신성력이 내게 왔어. 내 힘이 아니기: In any case, his untainted holy power came to me. It isn't mine, and I don't intend to claim it for myself.
...So I'll use it to open the door where Weiss is waiting.
strings.아, 그런데 벨로쉬가 봤다던 그 진리란 것은 무엇이었을까요?: What was that truth Belosh said he'd seen?
Something that doesn't belong to this world, I imagine...
strings.그런데 아발론에서 알게 된 게 뭔지 물어봐도 될까요?: May I ask what you learned in Avalon?
strings.물론이지. 그런데 들어도 괜찮겠어?: Of course. But are you sure you want to hear it?
strings.(프로즌이 손을 뻗자 정령 루우가 하늘 위로 올라간다. 잠시 후, 다시: (Frozen stretches out his hand, and Ruu rises into the sky. A moment later, the spirit returns and circles him, scattering motes of light.)
strings.초인들이 수레바퀴 밖으로 나와 흩어졌고, 지금 이오 님과 렌이 함께 있다: The Champions have left the Wheel and split up. Io and Ren are together now.
And while we're there, let's have Ren treat us.
strings.저 심각한 게 아니라서 굳이 치료까지는…. 아, 프로즌 님! 같이 가요!: It's nothing serious. I don't really need treatment... Ah, Frozen! Wait for me!
Thanks to you and the other Champions, Io, I could deal with so many enemies easily. Thank you.
There's no need. It's only what we should...
strings.(이오가 자신 앞에 쓰러진 악마들과 다른 세계의 존재들을 바라보다가 갑자: (Io looks at the demons and otherworldly beings fallen before her, then suddenly falls silent.)
strings.아니, 그게…. 모르겠어. 아발론의 축을 이루는 뭔가 하나 사라진 것 같: Well... I'm not sure. It feels like one of the things holding Avalon together has disappeared...
Shall we rest a moment? Though there's no time to rest...
Are you all right, Io? My sword will make you feel better.
strings.발드릭 아저씨는 벌써 열 번이나 베이고도 기분 좋다고 악마들 잡으러 갔으: Old Valdrick has been cut ten times already and still ran off to hunt demons, saying he felt wonderful. It clearly works...
But it feels a little strange to me. Oh, over there...
strings.렌! 이오! 괜찮아요?: Ren! Io! Are you all right?
I'm relieved to see you're both safe, Io, Ren.
strings.다행이에요. 그런데 다른 분들은 어디 계시죠?: That's good. Where are the others?
strings.수레바퀴에서 나와서 흩어졌어. 프로즌, 뭔가 할 말이 있는 거지?: We split up after leaving the Wheel. Frozen, you have something to say?
strings.네, 저와 이오 님이 알고 있고, 여신의 모험가가 알고 싶어하는 것입니다: Yes. Something you and I know, and the goddess's adventurer wishes to learn.
I see. Then... Ren, we're going somewhere quiet to talk for a moment. Please wait here.
strings.어디로 가시나요? 수레바퀴 안?: Where are you going? Inside the Wheel?
Somewhere I can't go, then. I'll wait.
Io, how do we reach Avalon's other side? With a snowball, perhaps...?
Ah, you must have done something with the Debora Snowfields' snow.
strings.%s, 그냥 나와 프로즌을 따라와. 그러다 보면 새로운 아발론이 보일 거: %s, just follow Frozen and me. Before long, you'll see a different Avalon.
strings.오래전 모두가 이상향이라 부르던 그런 완벽한 아발론은 아니지만, 적어도: It won't be the perfect Avalon people once called a paradise. But at least those otherworldly beings won't be there...
strings.(프로즌과 이오를 따라 몇 걸음 앞으로 나아갔을 뿐인데, %s의 시야에: (After only a few steps behind Frozen and Io, %s sees Avalon change, just as Io described.)
strings.(모래 안개가 자욱한 아발론은 바이스가 있었던 그 모습처럼 황량함과 쓸쓸: (Shrouded in sandy haze, Avalon is as desolate and lonely as it was when Weiss stood here.)
strings.여기는 아발론의 이면. 잠깐 들어와서 이야기하기엔 최적의 장소야. 그런데: This is Avalon's other side. A perfect place for a brief, quiet conversation. But you've seen it before, haven't you, %s?
strings.(이오와 프로즌에게 여기 오기 전 칼리 마을에서 잠깐 봤었던 이야기를 한: (You tell Io and Frozen about the brief vision you saw in Kali before coming here.)
You would have come here eventually, even without that witch's tricks. This place... Well, we should tell you, %s.
strings.지스카드 님께 들었겠지. 모두 속박의 힘으로 돌아갔다고. 정확히는 마석이: Ziskad must have told you everyone was reduced to the power of binding. To be precise, they became magic stones.
strings.지금 이곳은 거대한 마석이라고 보면 돼. 정확하게는 마석으로 만든 힘이: You can think of this whole place as one enormous magic stone. The power produced by the stones is being amplified, calling to the world where the Twisted One resides.
strings.그게 전부 마석이 됐다고요?: All of them became magic stones?
strings.수백년동안 죽어간 생명들의 힘으로 만들어진 마석들이 덩어리를 이뤄서 아발: Stones formed from lives lost over hundreds of years have been gathered into masses and erected throughout Avalon.
I examined the remnants that drifted into the Debora Snowfields. They belonged to the Deimos cult. Organisms made from magic stones... imitations of life, of humans.
The soldiers and fanatics of the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos were originally human.
strings.그들은 바이스를 믿고 데이모스라는 신을 믿고 따르던 신도들이었지만, 시간: They were believers who followed Weiss and the god called Deimos. But over time, they were replaced by something else.
strings.너도 알고 있겠지만, 그건 마석이다. 반과 마라가 바이스에게서 얻은 힘으: As you know, those were magic stones. Ban and Mara made them using the power Weiss gave them. Made from the power of living things...
strings.너도 봤을 거야.. 아드리카에서 칼리 족의 흉내를 내고, 데보라 설원에서: You must have seen them. They imitated the Kali tribe in Adrica, and hunted in the Debora Snowfields wearing the faces of our ancestors...
strings.모두 마석으로 만들어진 유기체야. 유기체들이 데려온 생명들이 모두 마석이: All organisms made from magic stones. Every life they brought in became another stone. Eventually, even those organisms reverted to stone.
strings.그렇게 아발론에 뿌려져 데이모스를 소환하는 양분이 된 것 같아. 데이모스: Scattered across Avalon, they seem to have become fuel for summoning Deimos. I suppose a summoning like that would require at least that much...
strings.그래서 우리는 오래전 샤이닉 언니가 수레바퀴에서 봉인했던 힘을 나눠 가졌: That's why we divided up the power Shynic sealed in the Wheel long ago.
I can't lie with you looking at me like that, %s.
We'll be all right. We're prepared.
strings.너도 너 나름의 정의가 있을 텐데…. 지금 여기 온 널 말린다면 너는 그: You have your own sense of justice... If someone tried to stop you now that you've come all this way, would you give up?
strings.%s, 우릴 몰라? 너무 걱정하지 마. 그 힘으로 아발론 곳곳에 있는 마: %s, you know us. Don't worry so much. We're using that power to destroy every magic stone scattered through Avalon. The effects should... Hm?
(Before Io can finish, Avalon's landscape trembles as though warping. Voices call to her.)
strings.이오, 어디야? 나와!!: Io! Where are you? Come out!
strings.이오!! 재미없는 일 끝나가니까 그 문으로 와!!: Io! We're nearly done with the boring part! Come to the door!
Lady Io, you can come now.
strings.이오, 그쪽으로 오게. %s도!!: Io, meet us there. You too, %s!
Well done, everyone. All of you except Lord Atkina, gather there.
strings.프로즌은 돌아가면 렌과 우리를 쫓아오는 다른 세계의 존재들을 쓰러뜨려 줘: Frozen, when we return, join Ren and defeat the otherworldly beings pursuing us.
Won't you need holy power to open the door?
strings.여긴 우리에게 맡겨. 그 신성력은 교단과 이리스 님을 위해 아껴두는 편이: Leave this to us. Save that holy power for the order and Lady Iris.
strings.%s, 너도 이리스 님을 위해서 힘을 아껴둬. 부탁이야. 우리는 널 믿어: %s, save your strength for Iris, too. Please. We believe in you...
strings.(이오가 %s에게 다가가 살며시 안아준다. 얼음과 눈을 다루는 사람이라고: (Io steps close and gently embraces %s. Her warmth seems at odds with someone who commands ice and snow.)
Let's go out now. Jump on the count of two.
(You leap forward after Io into a sand-laden wind that feels different. Back in the Avalon haunted by otherworldly beings, Ren is nowhere to be seen.)
We came out somewhere else. I'm still not used to this...
Still, we're near Vanitas, in a relatively safe area.
strings.프로즌, 그러면 렌하고 수레바퀴 방향을 부탁해. 다른 곳은 발드릭 아저씨: Frozen, take Ren and guard the way to the Wheel. Old Valdrick cleared the other areas, so the Wheel must be protected.
Then I'll go straight to Ren.
strings.(프로즌이 렌이 있는 방향으로 서둘러 뛰어가자 이오가 가볍게 %s의 어깨: (As Frozen hurries toward Ren, Io gives %s a light pat on the shoulder.)
Everyone is waiting inside. Let's not keep them.
I want to see for myself what Weiss calls Purgatory...
strings.(불길한 기운이 흘러나오는 수상한 문 안으로 들어가자 보이는 풍경이 모두: (They enter the strange door leaking sinister energy, and the sight within captures everyone's attention.)
strings.(생명이라고는 보이지 않는 폐허 위로 눈 부신 빛이 흘러내린다. 고개를: (Dazzling light pours over lifeless ruins. Above, a white staircase stretches through the clouds toward somewhere unseen.)
Somewhere here, there must be a path to those stairs climbing into the sky. Weiss will surely be there.
strings.(이오가 낯설지 않은 사람과 눈이 마주치자 싸늘한 미소를 짓는다. 잠시: (Io meets the eyes of a familiar figure and smiles coldly. The chill flowing around her stops, then sharpens into slender icicles.)
What luck. We can settle this right here.
What are you saying...? What is that supposed to mean...?
strings.(이오 주위를 맴돌던 고드름이 바이스의 가슴으로 향한다. 하지만, 고드름: (The icicles around Io fly at Weiss's chest. But they pass through him and shatter against a distant building.)
strings.(으윽, 귀, 귀가 아파…. 아드키나 님이 말씀하실 때처럼….): (Ugh! My ears... Just like when Lord Atkina spoke...)
strings.(바이스의 입에서 단어 하나가 나올 때마다 흘러나오는 기운이 %s의 귀에: (Every word from Weiss's mouth carries a force that stabs into %s's ears like an awl.)
strings.신의 언어로 말하지 말고, 인간의 언어로 말해!! 데이모스!!: Speak the language of humans, not gods! Deimos!!
strings.(분명 바이스는 아니야. 하지만, 속박의 힘이 ….): (It definitely isn't Weiss. But that power of binding...)
strings.(데이모스라 불린 바이스 외형의 존재가 가볍게 고개를 끄덕인다.): (The being with Weiss's appearance, addressed as Deimos, nods lightly.)
Forgive me, children who follow Seres.
strings.(분명 바이스의 모습이지만, 바이스가 아니야. 데이모스…라면 진짜 신이: (He looks like Weiss, but he isn't. If this is Deimos... Has the real god descended?)
strings.그대가 의심하고 있지만, 괜찮다. 그대가 느끼는 불안한 감정은 내가 갇힌: You doubt me, and that is understandable. The unease you feel comes from the magic stone in which I am imprisoned.
strings.나는 그대들이 알고 있는 뒤틀린 자. 정확히는 데이모스의 편린…. 잠들어: I am the one you know as a Twisted One. More precisely, a fragment of Deimos... I know it was not you who woke me from my slumber.
It must have been the one you call Weiss.
strings.이 세계에 신과 뒤틀린 자들이 비스트라 부르던 혼돈에 소멸해던 때, 데이: When the chaos you call the Beast annihilated gods and Twisted Ones in this world, the brothers Deimos and Phobos left, as others did.
strings.한때는 이곳을 사랑했던 자들이었지만, 그들 또한 극한의 공포와 무력감 앞: They once loved this place. But before such overwhelming terror and helplessness, they, too, had no choice but to leave.
There were those like Seres, and those who fell into other worlds.
strings.그리고 그들은 다시 이곳에 돌아오지 않기로 약속했다. 다시 돌아올 생각도: They promised never to return. Nor did they intend to.
strings.아주 잠깐, 우리가 사랑했던 생명의 부름이 있었다. 그래서 포보스는 자신: For a brief moment, we heard a call from the lives we had loved. Phobos sent a fragment of himself to investigate.
strings.편린은 다시 돌아오지 못했다. 마석의 기운에 휩쓸려 누군가의 종이 되어버: That fragment never returned. Overwhelmed by the magic stones' energy, it became someone's servant.
strings.데이모스 또한 사랑했던 생명의 부름이 있었기에 그걸 확인하고자 편린인 나: Deimos also heard the call of the lives he once loved. To investigate, he sent me, his fragment.
strings.데이모스의 편린인 내가 이렇게 붙잡히는 건 예상하지 못했다. 바이스로 위: He did not expect me to be captured. Trapped like this in a magic stone disguised as Weiss...
strings.뒤틀린 자인 당신의 능력이 고작 그 정도야?: Is that all a Twisted One like you can do?
strings.나는 그저 본체의 일부…. 바이스가 나를 부른 생명의 힘이 나를 능가했다: I am merely part of the whole... The power of the lives Weiss used to summon me surpassed my own.
strings.이제 이 마석이 편린인 나의 힘을 그에게 전송할 것이다. 그리고 다른 시: Now this stone will transmit my power to him. Then it will summon fragments of Deimos from other times and places.
strings.데이모스가 가지고 있는 편린의 수는 이 세계에 존재하는 정령의 수보다 많: Deimos has more fragments than this world has spirits.
strings.편린들이 위대한 벽을 뚫고 이곳에 당도한다면, 아무리 이곳에 오고 싶어: If they pierce the Great Wall and arrive here, even Deimos, who has no wish to return, will be compelled to answer the power of the lives Weiss has gathered.
A divine being forced to act against its will...
strings.너도 알것이다. 이곳을 사랑한 신급 존재들이 너희와 크게 다르지 않음을…: Surely you know. The divine beings who loved this place are not so different from you...
I will sever my connection to Deimos, to delay the arrival of the other fragments as long as possible...
...And as always, you are someone the gods would cherish...
strings.(데이모스의 편린이 점점 굳어져 아무런 말도 하지 않는다. 바이스의 모습: (The fragment of Deimos gradually hardens and falls silent. Only a mass of magic stone in Weiss's shape remains.)
strings.저 안으로 뒤틀린 자의 힘이 흘러간 게 느껴져. 바이스에게로 갔겠지. 편: I can feel the Twisted One's power flowing further inside. To Weiss, no doubt. Are fragments like souls? They seem to enter magic stones, then move elsewhere...
strings.벨레드란 악마가 그런 경우였을 거고. 페타에게서 실바리아 제국의 마법청이: That must have been what happened to the demon Veled. Feta told me the Silvaria Empire's Magic Bureau worked on transferring magic golem souls.
strings.(잠깐, 용병단 주둔지 근처 동굴에서 작은 데고스를 만났던 일도….): (Wait. What about the little Degos I met in the cave near the Mercenary Camp...?)
strings.지금은 깊게 생각할 필요 없어. 벌써 다른 초인들이 바이스를 찾으러 갔어: Don't dwell on it now. The other Champions are already searching for Weiss. We have to go, too. Hurry!
strings.(그래, 지금은 눈 앞의 일부터 해결하자. 그건 나중에 생각하고….): (Yes. Deal with what's in front of me first. I can think about that later...)
strings.(모험가가 쓰러뜨린 다른 세계의 존재들이 보라색 불꽃으로 변해 연옥 안으: (The otherworldly beings the adventurer defeats turn into purple flames and flow deeper into Purgatory.)
strings.(그 기운을 따라 도착한 장소에는 초인들이 다른 모습으로 변한 바이스와: (Following that energy leads to the Champions confronting a transformed Weiss. The fight is one-sided: he repels them effortlessly.)
Cough, cough... Shynic, fall back. I'll go next...
strings.(샤이닉이 데스사이드를 붙잡고 겨우 일어선다.): (Shynic barely manages to stand, leaning on her scythe.)
strings.지스카드 아저씨, 죽으면 끝이야! 저기, 메디아! 이 사람들 붙잡고 치료: Ziskad, if you die, that's it! Medea! Keep them back and heal them. That idiot and I will manage until Io comes.
strings.나는 문제 없다. 그런데 바이스 놈은 왜 공격하지 않는 거지?: I'm fine. But why isn't Weiss attacking?
strings.(그런 그때, 갑자기 바이스에게로 날카롭고 긴 고드름이 날아온다. 바이스: (Suddenly, a long, sharp icicle flies at Weiss. He reaches out to deflect it, but it splits into fragments that pierce his arm.)
Now that I've taken the fragment of Deimos's power, all of this feels so tiresome.
Is everyone all right? %s and I are here...
Are you all okay? That's Weiss over there...
To have to deal with such insignificant creatures...
strings.(잠깐, 바이스의 표정이 미세하게 일그러졌어.): (Wait. His expression just changed a little.)
strings.(바이스가 창을 들자 그의 주위에서 거대한 폭발이 일어난다.): (Weiss raises his spear, and an enormous explosion erupts around him.)
...It isn't the power I knew Weiss to possess.
Part of the Twisted One Deimos's power is flowing into him.
strings.상관없어. 그 전에 때려잡으면 되니까. 꼬맹이가 준 힘도 있고, 우리가: Doesn't matter. We'll beat him before it gets there. We've got the power the little girl gave us, and together...
strings.때를 기다리고 있었어. 우리가 모이기를…. 다들 물러나!!: He was waiting. For us all to gather... Everyone, get back!
strings.(바이스가 입을 여는 순간, 알 수 없는 힘의 진동이 초인들에게로 향한다: (As Weiss opens his mouth, a vibration of unknown power reaches the Champions. They try to retreat at Shynic's warning, but their movements stop.)
Why are Deimos's words coming from Weiss's mouth...?
strings.저놈, 왜 신의 언어로 이야기하는 거지? 아니, 그렇다 쳐도 우리가 왜: Why is he speaking the language of gods? And even so, why can't we move?
The fragment of Deimos has stopped our time...
strings.(다들 혼란스러워하고 있을 때, 바이스가 갑자기 사라졌다 나타난 %s의: (Amid their confusion, %s vanishes and reappears, attacking Weiss. He blocks the strike.)
A soul buried in eternity, now awakened...
strings.(바이스의 말과 함께 저 멀리 쇠사슬로 감겨 있는 거대한 문이 하늘에서: (As Weiss speaks, an enormous door wrapped in chains descends from the sky. It is shut tight, secured by a massive lock.)
I have no idea what you're talking about... Why am I...?
strings.이 문이 너로 인해 열릴 것이고, 모두가 원하는 아즈라엘이 되어 구원을: You will open this door. Everything will become the Azrael we desire, and salvation will come. Over it, Deimos will rise again as a new god...
No! I won't let that happen to Iris...
strings.데이모스의 편린이 조금씩 도착하고 있군…. 오늘로 완벽한 열쇠에 가까워: The fragments of Deimos are arriving, little by little... Today has brought your soul closer to becoming a perfect key. I shall take it...
strings.(바이스와 %s 주위에 알 수 없는 장벽이 펼쳐지고, 초인들을 묶고 있던: (An unknown barrier forms around Weiss and %s, while the force restraining the Champions releases them.)
You who could not even become keys, watch from there and savor your helplessness...
strings.(초인들이 바이스를 공격하기 위해 다가가지만, 장벽에 가로막혀 아무것도: (The Champions move to attack Weiss, but the barrier blocks them completely.)
We can't even lay a finger on him...
I'll put all my strength into cutting through that barrier. Everyone, lend me...
Ziskad, touching it may endanger %s. For now, we must trust our adventurer and watch.
strings.아직 우리가 할 수 있는 일은 많아요. 저기 보세요. 바이스에게로 향하는: There's still plenty we can do. Look over there. Heading toward Weiss...
strings.(누가 먼저라 할 것도 없이 초인들이 한곳을 바라본다.): (All the Champions turn toward the same spot at once.)
strings.데이모스의 편린들과 다른 세계의 존재들입니다. 그들이 오지 못하도록, 바: Fragments of Deimos and beings from other worlds. We must stop them from coming, keep them from reaching Weiss.
I never want to regret anything again.
strings.(데이모스의 힘으로 각성한 바이스의 공격이 열쇠가 될 존재에게 계속해서: (Awakened by Deimos's power, Weiss relentlessly attacks the one who would become his key. His target endures as best they can, searching for an opening.)
strings.(바이스가 겨우 버티고 서있는 %s에게 다가가 무기를 겨눈다.): (Weiss approaches %s, who can barely remain standing, and levels his weapon.)
I will pierce your heart and make a key from your blood...
A being loved by this world's god, a key made from that being... It will suffice. To save my world, Azrael...
(An ominous force streams from Weiss's hand toward %s. Suddenly, a tremendous power rides the wind through the barrier and hurtles at Weiss.)
strings.(바이스가 놀라 피하지만, 그 힘은 다시 바이스에게로 향한다. 그리고 바: (Startled, Weiss dodges. But the power turns back toward him and immobilizes him.)
...Bound by the power of binding myself...
strings.나는 그의 여려 편린 중 하나. 편린의 힘을 이용하려는 아가슈라와 데이모: I am one of his many fragments. I have severed the connection between Deimos and the Agasura seeking to exploit his fragments' power.
strings.그는, 그리고 나는 이런 식으로 이곳에 오고 싶지 않았다. 내가 사랑했던: He never wished to come here this way. Nor did I. I never wished to see the lives I loved like this.
I came because the lives of this world called to me. That was all...
strings.너는 나를 농락했다. 네 응답에 반응한 나를 한없이 어리석고 뒤틀린 존재: You made a mockery of me. I answered your call, and you turned me into a hopelessly foolish, twisted being.
Is that it? You ruined so many lives merely for that...?
strings.(단단한 장벽 틈으로 들어오는 편린들이 점차 모여 수상한 그림자를 만든다: (Fragments pass through gaps in the solid barrier, gathering into an eerie shadow.)
strings.그 영감은 별의 운명을 너무 쉽게 보곤 해. 그래서 너 같은 존재를 만들: That old man takes the fate of stars too lightly. That is why he keeps creating beings like you and sending them here.
strings.이 별은 신들이 버린 생명이 지킨 곳이다. 그리고 그런 생명을 위한 신이: This star was protected by lives the gods abandoned. And there were gods who lived for those lives. I may not be their equal, but for their sake...
I will sever the contract between you and that old man, even if it exhausts the fragments' power...
strings.(편린들이 이뤄져 만들어진 그림자가 조금씩 조각나기 시작한다. 그때마다: (The shadow formed by the fragments begins to break apart. With each piece, Weiss's body, which used Deimos's power, also crumbles and vanishes.)
strings.네가 이 세계에 가한 고통의 일부다. 이 세계를 없애려고 했던 영감이 형: This is a fraction of the pain you inflicted on this world. The terror of chaos and the abyss the old man hurled at my brethren when he sought to destroy this world... Feel it. The annihilation they felt.
strings.바이스, 네가 아는 세계는 존재하지 않는다. 달리 변한 아즈라엘만 남아있: Weiss, the world you knew no longer exists. Only an Azrael changed into something else remains.
strings.가이아여. 세레스가 선택한 인간에게서 이 별의 과거와 미래를 봤다. 미안: Gaia. In the human Seres chose, I saw this star's past and future. Forgive me...
strings.이제 나는 사라질 것이다. 다시 나타나는 일은 없을 것이다. 적어도 이: Now I will disappear. I will not appear again. At least, not in this world, in this form...
And I leave this man's end to you.
strings.(다른 이들이 뭐라 할 틈도 없이 데이모스의 편린이었던 그림자가 바이스와: (Before anyone can reply, the shadow that was Deimos's fragments seizes the door that appeared with Weiss. A moment later, door and shadow shatter together, vanishing without a trace.)
strings.쿨럭, 쿨럭…. 그저 아즈라엘을 살리고 싶어서 그 자의 말을 믿어보기로: Cough, cough... I only wanted to save Azrael. So I decided to believe that man's words...
The contract was against me from the beginning. A body that could do nothing but sin...
strings.생명의 힘을 사용해서 마석을 만드는 것이 전부라 믿었다. 아즈라엘을 위한: I believed all I had to do was make magic stones from the power of living things. For Azrael, he said. For my world, I... I...
strings.나는 어느 순간부터 아즈라엘보다 나를 위했지. 이 땅의 생명을 마석으로: At some point, I began doing it for myself rather than Azrael. Turning this land's lives into magic stones...
You can't use this world for the sake of your own...
strings.어차피 멸망할 세계라면 아즈라엘을 위해서 쓰는 것이 좋겠다고 생각했을 뿐: I merely thought a world doomed to perish might as well serve Azrael...
If I were born again, I would do the same...
Huh? Shynic...? How did you... Oh, because of the fragments...
strings.(장벽이 언제 사라졌는지, %s의 앞으로 샤이닉이 다가온다.): (The barrier has disappeared, unnoticed. Shynic steps in front of %s.)
strings.네 손을 더럽히게 하고 싶지 않아서 그래. 어차피 더러운 거라면 내가 한: I don't want you to dirty your hands. If someone's hands must be dirty, let mine be dirtied once more.
strings.내가 한다고 하니 다들 말리지 않았어. 내가 부탁했거든. 후우…. 다른: The others didn't stop me. I asked them to let me do it. Sigh... They'll be waiting where Frozen is.
strings.(샤이닉이 활짝 웃으며 %s의 어깨를 툭 친다. 그리고 속박에 붙잡힌 채: (Shynic smiles brightly and taps %s's shoulder, then looks at Weiss, suffering in his bonds.)
Weiss. The gods of this world you mocked, and their power. I happen to have some left. I'll give it all to you.
You should never have come here. And you should never have made me like this.
strings.나는…. 나는…. 나는!! 더는 죽이고 싶지 않다고! 하지만, 딱 한 번: I... I... I don't want to kill anymore! But just once more... I'll end it with you.
You must suffer. You have to.
strings.그런 의미로 페르세가 내게 남겨준 선물을 내게 줄게. 명계조차 가지 못한: So I'll give you the gift Perse left me. Can you hear the bitter resentment of souls that couldn't even reach the Underworld?
strings.(샤이닉이 두 손으로 데스사이드를 들어 휘두른다. 시공간이 잘린 듯한 틈: (Shynic swings her scythe with both hands. Black spheres pour from a tear that seems to slice through spacetime and race toward Weiss.)
strings.(검은 구체들이 그대로 바이스의 몸을 관통하더니 다시 들러붙는다.): (The black spheres pierce Weiss's body, then cling to it.)
strings.크윽, 그래도 나는 후회하지 않는다…. 다만 그곳을 다시 갈 수 없다는: Urgh... Even so, I have no regrets... I only long for that place I can never return to...
Longing for a happier time long ago is regret.
strings.(검은 구체들이 다시 모여 거대한 칼날이 되고, 그대로 웃고 있던 바이스: (The black spheres gather into an enormous blade and pierce the still-smiling Weiss's heart. Purple flames consume what remains of his body.)
strings.(그렇게 이스트랜드의 모든 생명을 삼켰던 악이 자신에게서 퍼져나온 보라색: (Thus the evil that devoured Eastland's lives is swallowed by its own purple flames and an unknowable darkness, and disappears.)
%s, I lost something here. Wait where Frozen is. I'll be out soon.
Let's go together. I can help you look.
No. You wouldn't be able to find it. Only I can...
strings.…네, 알았어요. 그러면 빨리 나오세요. 이 공간이 앞으로 어떻게 될지: ...All right. But come out quickly. We don't know what will happen to this place...
strings.(그렇게 모든 게 끝난 것 같은 공간에서 %s의 모습이 사라지자 혼자 남: (Once %s leaves the place where everything seems to have ended, Shynic looks around, alone.)
Weiss, I don't like you, even at the very end.
strings.아, %s…. 다행이야. 괜찮은 거야?: Ah, %s... Thank goodness. Are you all right?
strings.저는 괜찮아요. 다들 여기 계셨네요. 별일 없죠?: I'm fine. You're all here. Nothing happened, did it?
strings.그래, 아무 일도 없어. 신의 힘과 더불어 아발론에 있던 속박의 힘이 사: No, nothing. The divine power and Avalon's binding have disappeared, so Weiss must be...
She said she'd find something she lost and come out.
She lost something? Hmm. All right.
Let's wait a little. She'll be here soon.
I wanted to finish him myself...
strings.지스카드 님, 이오 님…. 저는 돌아가는 대로 성역과 교단에 이를 알리겠: Ziskad, Io... As soon as I return, I'll report this to the sanctuary and the order.
strings.(루우가 사라지고, 멀리 모래 안개 사이로 검은 빛이 피어오른다.): (Ruu disappears, and a black light rises through the distant sandy haze.)
That black thing... No, surely not.
strings.발드릭 경, 이리로!! 생각하는 게 맞습니다!!: Sir Valdrick, over here! It's exactly what you think!
Shynic is in danger. Shynic! Everyone, go on ahead...
strings.(메디아가 서둘러 연옥의 문으로 향하려고 하자 지스카드가 붙잡는다.): (Medea hurries toward Purgatory's door, but Ziskad stops her.)
Medea, calm down and listen. Shynic will be all right.
Medea, we're all in danger if we stay here.
strings.샤이닉을 믿고 우리를 믿고 수레바퀴로 돌아갈 생각을 하게. 샤이닉도 거기: Trust Shynic, and trust us. Focus on getting back to the Wheel. She'll know it's safe there and come to us.
strings.루우, 그러면 거기서 기다리고 있는 렌에게 가서 수레바퀴로 가라고 해!!: Ruu, find Ren where she's waiting and tell her to go to the Wheel!
strings.(메디아를 걱정하듯 주위를 맴돌던 정령 루우가 프로즌의 말을 듣고 그대로: (Ruu, circling Medea as though worried about her, hears Frozen and flies straight into the sky.)
strings.(수레바퀴로 갈 준비를 하면서도 메디아가 여전히 커져가는 시공간의 틈으로: (Even while preparing to return to the Wheel, Medea cannot look away from the growing rift. At last, Io taps Valdrick on the shoulder.)
Old man, put Medea on your shoulder. Quickly.
If we don't, I think she'll run over there... I'll leave her to you.
strings.(말이 끝나자마자 발드릭이 한 손으로 메디아를 들어 어깨에 태운다. 그리: (Valdrick lifts Medea onto his shoulder with one hand, then runs toward the Burning Wheel faster than ever.)
strings.(불타는 수레바퀴 안으로 들어가자마자 아드키나가 서둘러 앞으로 걸어 나온: (As soon as they enter the Burning Wheel, Atkina hurries forward.)
strings.시간이 없으니 다들 내 뒤로 오게!! 거기 렌 양도 멍하니 있지 말고 프: No time! Everyone, behind me! Ren, don't stand there staring. Get behind me with Frozen.
strings.죄송합니다! 아, 아드리카 님! 아니, 아드키나 님!: I'm sorry! Lord Adrica! I mean, Lord Atkina!
She said she had something to find and told me to go ahead...
strings.흠…. 그러면 샤이닉 빼고 전부 도착한 건가?: Hmm... So everyone except Shynic is here?
strings.(아드키나가 무사히 도착한 일행을 확인하고 조용히 눈을 감는다.): (Having confirmed the others arrived safely, Atkina closes his eyes.)
strings.(아드키나의 용언으로 짐작되는 소리가 모두의 귓가에 닿자마자 일행의 주위: (As what sounds like Atkina's Dragon Speech reaches their ears, a warm barrier forms around them.)
This will only take a moment.
We leave it to you, Lord Atkina.
strings.(아드키나가 제자리에서 날개짓을 하더니 천천히 허공으로 날아오른다. 그리: (Atkina beats his wings and slowly rises into the air, watching the black hole approach the Wheel.)
Absolute One. This world is not as weak as you imagine.
strings.(아드키나의 이마에 있던 보석이 밝게 빛나고, 그의 주위를 맴돌고 있던: (The jewel on Atkina's forehead shines brightly. Blue light swirling around him gathers in his chest.)
strings.(그 힘을 주체할 수 없는 강력한 드래곤의 포효가 계속 이어지면서 수레바: (The powerful dragon's unrestrained roar goes on and on, shaking the Wheel.)
strings.다들 잘 붙잡아!! 바닥이 꺼질지도 모르니까!!: Everyone, hold on! The floor might give way!
strings.(순간, 아드키나의 눈빛이 붉게 변하면서 목부터 모여져 있던 힘이 거대한: (Suddenly, Atkina's eyes turn red. The power gathered in his throat erupts as an enormous blast of dragon breath.)
strings.(검은 구멍이 드래곤의 브레스와 닿자마자 뒤틀리기 시작한다. 도저히 이: (The black hole twists the moment the dragon's breath touches it. A sound unlike anything of this world torments them, then fades.)
(Once the black hole has vanished, Atkina slowly descends, coughing.)
strings.아드키나 님, 괜찮으세요?: Are you all right, Lord Atkina?
strings.오랜만에 힘을 사용했더니 조절하기 쉽지 않더군. 쿨럭, 쿨럭. 역시 나이: It's been so long since I used my power that controlling it was difficult. Cough, cough... Age catches up with us all...
The rift has vanished without a trace.
An ancient Pluton dragon indeed! Lord Atkina, that was magnificent.
He's on a whole other level.
She restored part of the fractured Great Wall and lent me that strength.
strings.아발론에 있던 다른 세계의 존재들이 그 구멍으로 들어가 사라진 것 같습니: The otherworldly beings in Avalon seem to have vanished into that hole... But...
Shynic... I can't feel Shynic's presence...
strings.(메디아가 순간적으로 다리에 힘이 풀렸는지 그대로 주저앉는다.): (Medea's legs suddenly give way, and she sinks to the floor.)
...What were you trying to find? Why didn't you come with us, Shynic...?
I... I should have stayed with her...
strings.(다들 아무 말도 하지 못하고 있던 그때, 수레바퀴 안쪽에서 거대한 무언: (As everyone falls silent, something enormous crashes down deeper inside the Wheel.)
strings.(무너진 바닥 사이에서 작은 손 하나가 짠~하는 느낌으로 솟아오른다.): (A small hand pops up through the broken floor, almost as if announcing, 'Ta-da!')
strings.나 이번엔 진짜 죽는단 말이야!!: I'm really going to die this time!
strings.(드래곤 아드키나가 샤이닉의 기운을 느끼고 숨을 들이쉬자, 무너진 바닥을: (Atkina senses Shynic's presence and inhales. Shynic rises into the air, barely having held onto the broken floor.)
I nearly died, but it was rather fun.
strings.샤이닉 님, 그런 위험을 겪고도 그런 소리를 하시다니…. 하아…. 그래도: Shynic, how can you say that after such danger...? Sigh... Still, thank goodness you're safe.
strings.(샤이닉이 올라와 가볍게 착지하고 기지개를 핀다. 그 모습을 보고 있던: (Shynic lands lightly and stretches. Everyone watching her sighs in relief.)
You had us worried, little girl.
Shynic, I told you not to wander into danger. Yet you've done it again.
Honestly, you old men... Still treating me like a child.
strings.응, 괜찮아. 잘 봐. 기지개할 때, 뼈 마디마다 소리가 나긴 하지만,: Yes, I'm fine. Look. Every joint cracks when I stretch, but I'm fine.
strings.일반인이라면 시공간의 틈으로 빨려들어갔을 텐데…. 대체 뭘 찾으러 가신: An ordinary person would have been sucked into the rift... What on earth did you go looking for?
strings.샤이닉 님, 지금 컨디션이 좋지 않으시니까 제가 베어드릴게요. 샤이닉 님: You're not in good condition, Shynic. Let me cut you. For you, a hundred slashes should do it...
No thanks. I think I'd die...
strings.(메디아가 평소라면 장난처럼 이야기했을 샤이닉이 다른 분위기로 말을 꺼내: (The changed tone of words Shynic would normally say in jest makes Medea realize something. She approaches carefully and takes both her hands.)
strings.당신이 이곳에서 모두에게 나눠준 페르세의 힘은 당신이 가진 죽음을 이겨내: The power of Perse you shared with everyone here... It was your power to overcome death.
Shynic, you truly put your life on the line this time...
strings.샤이닉, 줄게 있다면서 우리를 자리에 있게 한 게…. 짐작은 했네. 그래: Shynic, when you said you had something to give us and made us take our places... I suspected as much. But even so...
strings.나 혼자만 살고 싶지 않았거든. 어차피 그 힘이 여기선 모두에게 도움이: I didn't want to be the only one who survived. That power would help everyone here... Better them than me...
Don't say things like that. That you're going to die, or that you nearly died...
strings.(메디아가 등을 돌린 채 말을 잇지 못하는 샤이닉을 그대로 안아버린다.): (As Shynic turns away, unable to speak, Medea pulls her into an embrace.)
strings.(이오가 두 사람의 모습을 보더니 그대로 달려가 안아버린다.): (Seeing the two, Io runs over and hugs them both.)
strings.스승도 이걸 본다면 분명 기뻐하셨을 텐데. 그게 아쉽군. 바보 같은 놈이: My master would've been so happy to see this. I wish she could. To see this fool working together with so many people...
strings.하늘에서도 지켜보고 계실 겁니다. 저도 그동안 했던 일의 끝이 온 것 같: I'm sure she's watching from above. I feel as though the work I've done all these years has finally reached its end.
strings.정말 끝났네요…. 이스트랜드에서 여러분을 만나고 정말 많은 일들이 있었네: It's really over... So much has happened since I met you all in Eastland.
What's this? You sound like you'll never see us again.
strings.에이, 아니에요. 앞으로도 여러분에게 도움을 많이 받을 거 같아요. 아직: Of course not. I'm sure I'll need plenty more help from you. There's still so much left to do...
Just say the word. Wherever you call, little sibling, I'll come running and tear things up. But sparring is mandatory.
strings.세상에!! 아드키나 님이 배고프시다니!! 그러면 다 같이 저희 마을로 가: Goodness! Lord Atkina is hungry! Then let's all go to our village. There's plenty of food waiting. Everyone, come!
strings.나도 배고팠는데, 마침 잘 됐군. 고기, 고기!!: I was hungry too. Perfect timing. Meat! Meat!
It really feels like all our hard work is finally over, Frozen.
strings.아, 여러분. 아발론은 전에 협의드린 것처럼 빛의 연합과 세레스 교단 분: Oh, everyone. As we agreed earlier, Avalon will be managed by the Alliance of Light and a branch of the Seres Order.
strings.시공간의 틈이 사라졌다고 해서 일이 모두 끝난 건 아닙니다. 어떻게든 다: The disappearance of the rift doesn't mean our work is done. We must purify this land and make it a home for life again.
Lord Atkina will handle part of the purification in his dragon form.
strings.가이아 님께서 허락하셨으니 고향에 잠깐 다녀온 다음 바로 이곳에 있을 생: Lady Gaia has given her permission. I'll visit my homeland briefly, then stay here. I don't know how long it will take, but we'll make it like Adrica.
strings.(그러고 보니 가이아 님이 요즘 통 안 보이시네….): (Come to think of it, I haven't seen Lady Gaia at all lately...)
strings.프로즌, 수레바퀴에 더는 죽음의 힘도 없으니까 여기도 맡길게. 절대 귀찮: Frozen, there's no death power left in the Wheel. I'll leave it to you, too. Definitely not because it's a hassle. ♡
strings.감사합니다. 교단에서 새로운 통로를 뚫어야 하나 생각했는데, 수고를 덜었: Thank you. The order was considering opening a new passage, so you've saved us the trouble.
strings.이번만 약주 드시는 거 눈감아드릴게요. 유란 언니에겐 이야기하지 않을게요: Just this once, I'll turn a blind eye if you have a drink. I won't tell Yuran.
Hahaha! Thank you. Come along, then.
strings.(이오가 조용히 다가와 %s의 손을 잡아당겨 끌어안는다. 그리고 조용히: (Io quietly approaches, takes %s's hand, and draws them into an embrace, gently patting their shoulder.)
strings.너무 걱정하지 마. 너는 앞으로도 잘 해낼 거야. 좋은 사람들과 함께여서: Don't worry too much. You'll do well from here on, too. You accomplished all this with good people beside you, didn't you?
And don't forget that we were among those good people.
strings.다들 이제 속박과 관련된 기억에서 조금씩 벗어날 거야. 또 다른 미래를: Everyone will slowly move beyond their memories of binding. They'll live dreaming of another future. Thank you for giving us that future.
I'll spend the rest of my life for everyone's sake, and for Lady Iris.
strings.이제 보니 %s, 표정이 다양하네. 그렇게 감동받은 표정도 다 지을 수: You have quite a range of expressions, %s. Even that deeply moved look.
strings.처음엔 바보 같은 표정이었는데♡: At first, you only looked silly. ♡
strings.하하하하, 바보면 어때? 다들 고기 먹으러 가자고!! 고기 천재!!: Hahahaha! Who cares if we're fools? Let's go eat meat! Meat genius!
strings.자, 그러면 우리 마을의 설화로 가자구요!: Come on, then. To our village's Snowflower Inn!
strings.(메디아가 게르다의 이곳저곳을 두리번거리며 구경하자 이오가 뿌듯한 표정을: (As Medea looks around Gerda with interest, Io beams with pride.)
strings.여러분, 갈렛에게는 이야기 다 했으니까 들어가서 조금만 기다리면 된답니다: I've told Galette everything. Go inside and wait just a moment, everyone.
strings.하핫, 역시 고기는 이 집이 최고야!: Haha! This place really does have the best meat!
strings.…맛있는 냄새가 나는군. 음식이 먹고 싶다는 생각이 드는 걸 보면 나도: ...What a delicious smell. I must have used a great deal of strength if I'm craving food.
Hardly. You all did the work.
Ren, thank you for everything. Rest in Eastland for a while and find something you'd like to do.
I will. I was planning to stay in Gerda a little longer anyway.
strings.(다들 즐거워 보여. 이스트랜드의 일이 끝나서겠지….): (Everyone looks happy. Because our work in Eastland is finished...)
strings.어, 여신님? 오, 반가워! 같이 고기 먹으러 가자!: Oh, Goddess? Good to see you! Come eat meat with us!
strings.(뒤를 돌아보니 언제 나타났는지 이리스가 난처한 표정으로 초인을 비롯한: (Turning around, you find Iris standing before the Champions and their companions, looking a little awkward. No one noticed her arrive.)
It's been a while, Lady Iris.
strings.여신님, 그거 재미있는 일이야? 그러면 나도 데려가♡: Goddess, is it something fun? Take me along if it is. ♡
Shynic, show the goddess some respect.
Don't be like that, Medea. I'm making an effort in my own way.
It's quite all right, Medea, Shynic.
I'm sorry. I think I need to borrow the adventurer now.
strings.이리스…. 아니, 이리스 님. %s에게 볼 일이 있으셨군요. 자네, 준비: Iris... I mean, Lady Iris. You have business with %s, then. Get ready to go.
Goddess... We've only just met. I'd be so sorry to see you leave already.
I'll come visit Gerda again. Please don't be too disappointed.
%s, close your eyes and take my hand.
strings.(이리스와 %s의 손이 닿은 순간, 신비한 빛이 그들을 감싸고 어디론가: (The moment Iris and %s touch hands, a mysterious light surrounds them and carries them away.)
Then I'll eat my little sibling's share of the meat, too.
strings.(그렇게 두 사람을 배웅한 초인들이 설화 안으로 들어갈 때, 샤이닉이 제: (After seeing the two off, the Champions head into the Snowflower Inn. Shynic gently stops Medea, who is entering last.)
strings.(샤이닉이 품 안에서 뭔가 꺼내 메디아의 손에 쥐여준다.): (Shynic takes something from inside her clothes and places it in Medea's hand.)
strings.연옥에서 찾은 환영의 눈물이야. 메디아에게 줘야 할 것 같아서. 바이스가: A Tear of Illusion I found in Purgatory. I thought you should have it. Weiss seems to have made it through a contract with the rabbit witch...
strings.이스트랜드의 일이 끝나서 좋은데…. 뭔가 허전한 느낌이 들어…. 미안해,: I'm glad everything in Eastland is over... But I feel empty somehow... Sorry. I didn't mean to be like this...
strings.(이리스가 조심스레 다가가 살며시 안아준다.): (Iris approaches carefully and gently embraces you.)
I understand you, %s. Just as you understood me...
strings.믿음을 바탕으로 모두의 힘을 모아서 큰 일 을 해결했을 때…. 그리고: When everyone's strength comes together through trust to accomplish something great... And when something else comes afterward... I still remember that feeling. I can't forget it.
That uncertainty about what to do next...
But with time, I began to feel a little better.
You'll feel better with time, too, %s.
strings.다 괜찮을까? 괜찮아지겠지?: Will everything be all right? It will, won't it?
strings.함께 찾아봐요. 괜찮아질 때까지 같이 할게요. 당신이 절 위해서 해준: Let's find our way together. I'll stay with you until it is. Just as you did for me...
strings.(이리스가 환하게 웃으며 두 손을 잡아준다.): (Iris smiles brightly and takes both your hands.)
Thank you, Iris... I feel better now.
strings.그런데 나를 이곳으로 부른 거면 뭔가 이야기할 게 있는 거지?: But you brought me here because you have something to tell me, right?
strings.아마도 %s에게 느껴진 그 느낌의 실마리를 알 것 같아서…. 그걸 말씀드: I think I may have a clue to that feeling you've had, %s... That's what I wanted to tell you.
She said she would be going somewhere for a little while, then disappeared.
strings.가이아 님이 어디 계신지 계속 찾아보고 있지만, 확실한 건 이 세계에는: I've been searching for her, but one thing is certain. She isn't in this world.
strings.너무 걱정하지 마요. 제가 계속 위대한 벽을 따라가고 있으니…. 가이아: Don't worry too much. I'm continuing to follow the Great Wall... I'm sure she'll send us a message.
strings.응, 알았어. 나 좀 쉬었다가 다시 이리스를 위해 할 수 있는 일이 뭔지: Okay. I'll rest a little, then look for something else I can do for you.
There are things I want to ask Lady Gaia, too.
strings.네, 저도 가이아 님을 다시 만나고 싶거든요. 이제 제가 게르다로 보내드: Yes. I want to see her again as well. I'll send you back to Gerda now.
